entities.name: Kalinago (Carib) Era
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Kalinago (Island Caribs) displaced or absorbed the Arawak populations around 800 CE, renaming the island Hewanorra. They developed a warrior society with maritime raiding capabilities and fiercely resisted European colonization for centuries, making Saint Lucia one of the last Caribbean islands
